title: Desktop 整书结构解析与章节识别修复

commits.message: fix(desktop): import books with empty structural headings
fix(desktop): read tool books from bound snapshots

user_summary: 修复目录条目误判正文、引言与后记等结构单元漏切，以及末章吞入附属材料导致异常膨胀的问题。
technical_summary: Import now parses the whole document through normalized paragraph evidence, heading candidates, explicit and implicit TOC detection, global sequence resolution, typed unit boundaries, structure validation, and conservative oversized-unit repair. DOCX style metadata is retained. Analyzable routing counts introduction, chapters, and afterword while excluding front matter, notes, acknowledgements, and references. EPUB navigation documents are excluded from readable content, and heading-only structural units remain diagnostic-only instead of entering the legacy Chapter table. Comprehend now reads every analyzable chapter from the immutable snapshot bound to the run, so DOCX files without standard Heading styles cannot collapse into one front-matter section.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit and implicit table-of-contents entries never become body units when the real headings appear later.
Introduction, numbered chapters, afterword, notes, acknowledgements, appendices, and references retain distinct structure types and analyzability.
Oversized final units are rescanned for missing back-matter boundaries without book-title, chapter-number, or page-number special cases.
The Life 3.0 acceptance document resolves to introduction, chapters 1 through 8, and afterword as ten analyzable units, with notes and acknowledgements excluded from analysis routing.
EPUB navigation documents and heading-only structural units never create empty persisted chapters or fail an otherwise valid import.
Tool-book comprehend uses the run-bound snapshot, excludes supplementary units, and covers every analyzable imported chapter.
tests: Version, Change Registry, and project scaffold checks passed
Real Life 3.0 DOCX: 10 analyzable units, 8 numbered chapters, 1 TOC region, 0 warnings
Import regression suite (TXT/DOCX/EPUB, structure, formats, delete): 68 passed
Comprehend snapshot/planner/format suite: 44 passed; real read-only book 61 plans 22/22 imported analyzable chapters
verification_evidence: 用户于 2026-09-20 明确授权将包含本修复的 StoryLens Desktop v1.3.8 作为正式 GitHub Release 发布；自动化回归和真实数据只读复现证据已记录。

data_compatibility.notes: No schema migration. Newly imported or explicitly reparsed books retain typed section_type values in the existing column. Existing imported books remain readable and require reparse to obtain corrected boundaries.
